name: @ozjsey/v-scroll-into-view
description: Vue 3 directive for reactive scroll-into-view with edge detection, custom scroll container, and sticky-header offset — ideal for chat panes, modal lists, v-for active item, anchor navigation
author: Ozgur Seyidoglu

scripts.build: tsup vScrollIntoView.ts --format esm,cjs --minify --sourcemap --dts --out-dir dist --clean && mv dist/vScrollIntoView.js dist/vScrollIntoView.min.js && mv dist/vScrollIntoView.js.map dist/vScrollIntoView.min.js.map && mv dist/vScrollIntoView.cjs dist/vScrollIntoView.min.cjs && mv dist/vScrollIntoView.cjs.map dist/vScrollIntoView.min.cjs.map && mv dist/vScrollIntoView.d.cts dist/vScrollIntoView.min.d.cts && node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['vScrollIntoView.min.js','vScrollIntoView.min.cjs']){const p='dist/'+f;let s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');s=s.replace(/\/\/# sourceMappingURL=vScrollIntoView\.(js|cjs)\.map/, '//# sourceMappingURL='+f+'.map');fs.writeFileSync(p,s);}"
